@deskOutNotUpdated.description: Title of the toast on Outputs when the refresh could not ask the node; the reason follows as its text.

@deskOutTitle.description: Title of the Outputs page; also the screen reader label of the outputs table. Outputs are the coins the balance is made of.

@deskOutShowAmounts.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Outputs that shows the hidden amounts.

@deskOutHideAmounts.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Outputs that hides amounts.

@deskOutRefresh.description: Tooltip of the icon button on Outputs that asks the node for new data; also the button when the list could not be loaded.

deskOutLockedNote: Locked outputs are being spent by a transaction in progress. Their change shows as awaiting finalization and is not in Total until the send is finalized, so Total counts the coins once.

@deskOutLockedNote.description: Small note under the balance tiles on Outputs, shown while some outputs are locked.

deskOutIntro: Outputs are the pieces the balance is made of. A send spends whole outputs and returns the change as a new one.

@deskOutIntro.description: Intro paragraph on the Outputs page.

@deskOutCount.description: Number of outputs, small caption next to an amount in the balance tiles.

deskOutCardWait: Wait until the send confirms ({blocks, plural, one{about 1 block} other{about {blocks} blocks}}).

@deskOutCardWait.description: Note on the Split and Consolidate cards while a send is still locking outputs. {blocks} is the wallet's minimum confirmations (Settings > Advanced): blocks until the change confirms.

@deskOutSplitNothing.description: Note on the Split card when there are no spendable outputs.

@deskOutSplitSpends.description: Note on the Split card: how many outputs a split would spend.

deskOutSplitSpendsFee: {count, plural, one{Spends {count} output. Fee at least {fee} EPIC.} other{Spends {count} outputs. Fee at least {fee} EPIC.}}

@deskOutSplitSpendsFee.description: Note on the Split card: how many outputs a split would spend and the lowest fee.

@deskOutConsNothing.description: Note on the Consolidate card when there are no spendable outputs.

deskOutConsOne: Nothing to consolidate: one spendable output.

@deskOutConsOne.description: Note on the Consolidate card when there is only one spendable output.

deskOutConsInto: {count, plural, one{{count} output into 1.} other{{count} outputs into 1.}}

@deskOutConsInto.description: Note on the Consolidate card: how many outputs a consolidation merges into one.

deskOutConsIntoFee: {count, plural, one{{count} output into 1. Fee {fee} EPIC.} other{{count} outputs into 1. Fee {fee} EPIC.}}

@deskOutConsIntoFee.description: Note on the Consolidate card: how many outputs a consolidation merges into one, and its fee.

@deskOutSplitCardTitle.description: Title of the Split card on Outputs.

deskOutSplitCardText: Makes more outputs from the spendable balance, so several sends can follow each other without waiting.

@deskOutSplitCardText.description: Text of the Split card on Outputs.

@deskOutSplitCardButton.description: Button of the Split card; opens a dialog. Keep the ellipsis. Short.

@deskOutConsCardTitle.description: Title of the Consolidate card on Outputs.

deskOutConsCardText: Merges every spendable output into one. Smaller fees on the next send; everything is locked until it confirms.

@deskOutConsCardText.description: Text of the Consolidate card on Outputs.

@deskOutConsCardButton.description: Button of the Consolidate card; opens a dialog. Keep the ellipsis. Short.

@deskOutNotLoadedTitle.description: Title of the empty state on Outputs when the list could not be read.

@deskOutNotLoadedText.description: Text of the empty state on Outputs when the list could not be read.

@deskOutLoading.description: Line with a spinner on Outputs while the list loads.

@deskOutNoneTitle.description: Title of the empty state on Outputs when the wallet has no outputs.

deskOutNoneText: The first payment received makes one.

@deskOutNoneText.description: Text of the empty state on Outputs when the wallet has no outputs.

@deskOutFilterAll.description: Filter chip on Outputs: every output. Narrow chip; a count follows it.

@deskOutFilterSpendable.description: Filter chip on Outputs: outputs that can be spent now. Narrow chip; a count follows it.

@deskOutFilterConfirming.description: Filter chip on Outputs: outputs waiting for confirmations. Narrow chip; a count follows it.

@deskOutFilterLocked.description: Filter chip on Outputs: outputs locked by a send. Narrow chip; a count follows it.

@deskOutSearchHint.description: Placeholder of the search field on Outputs. A commitment is the output's technical identifier.

@deskOutSearchLabel.description: Screen reader label of the search field on Outputs.

@deskOutClearSearch.description: Tooltip of the button that empties the search field on Outputs.

@deskOutShowSpent.description: Checkbox on Outputs: also list outputs that were already spent.

@deskOutNoMatchTitle.description: Title of the empty state on Outputs when the search and filter show nothing.

deskOutNoMatchText: Try another commitment, or clear the filter.

@deskOutNoMatchText.description: Text of the empty state on Outputs when the search and filter show nothing.

@deskOutClearFilter.description: Button of the 'no match' state on Outputs: empties the search and resets the filter.

@deskOutTileSpendable.description: Label of a balance tile on Outputs: money that can be spent now. Narrow tile.

@deskOutTileConfirming.description: Label of a balance tile on Outputs: money waiting for confirmations. Narrow tile.

@deskOutTileImmature.description: Label of a balance tile on Outputs: mining rewards not yet spendable. Narrow tile.

@deskOutTileLocked.description: Label of a balance tile on Outputs: money locked in unfinished sends. Narrow tile.

@deskOutTileTotal.description: Label of a balance tile on Outputs: the whole balance. Narrow tile.

@deskOutAdvanced.description: Head of the management section under the outputs table: the intro paragraph, Split and Consolidate, the defaults for sends.

@deskOutStrategyTitle.description: Setting title in the Defaults panel: which outputs a send spends.

deskOutStrategyHint: Which outputs a send spends. Smallest spends the smallest outputs that cover the amount; All spends every output and returns one.

@deskOutStrategyHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Strategy for sends row (its title is deskOutStrategyHelpTitle).

@deskOutStrategySmallest.description: Option of the strategy switch: spend the smallest outputs. Narrow segment.

@deskOutStrategyAll.description: Option of the strategy switch: spend all outputs. Narrow segment.

@deskOutStrategyHelpTitle.description: Title of the toast that shows the strategy help.

@deskOutSplitChangeTitle.description: Setting title in the Defaults panel (a switch); also its screen reader label.

deskOutSplitChangeText: When a send would leave fewer than 3 spendable outputs and its change is at least 1 EPIC, the change comes back as up to 4 outputs of at least 0.5 EPIC each. Costs 0.004 EPIC per extra output.

@deskOutColValue.description: Column header of the outputs table: the amount. Narrow header, right aligned.

@deskOutColStatus.description: Column header of the outputs table. Narrow header.

@deskOutColConfirmations.description: Column header of the outputs table: number of confirmations. Narrow header, right aligned.

@deskOutColHeight.description: Column header of the outputs table: block height. Narrow header.

@deskOutColTransaction.description: Column header of the outputs table: the transaction the output belongs to. Narrow header.

@deskOutColCommitment.description: Column header of the outputs table: the output's technical identifier.

@deskOutStatusSpendable.description: Status of an output that can be spent. Narrow status column.

@deskOutStatusConfirming.description: Status of an output waiting for confirmations. Narrow status column.

@deskOutConfirmations.description: Small grey note after an output's status: how many confirmations it has. number is the count with thousands separators.

@deskOutStatusAwaiting.description: Status of an output of a payment still waiting to be finalized. Narrow status column.

@deskOutNoteWaitingSender.description: Small grey note after the status 'Awaiting finalization'. Lower case.

@deskOutStatusUnpaid.description: Status of an output made for an invoice that is not paid yet. Narrow status column.

@deskOutNoteNotInBalance.description: Small grey note after the status 'Unpaid invoice'. Lower case.

@deskOutStatusImmature.description: Status of a mining reward output that cannot be spent yet. Narrow status column.

deskOutNoteBlocksToGo: {count, plural, one{{number} confirmation to go} other{{number} confirmations to go}}

@deskOutNoteBlocksToGo.description: Small grey note after the status 'Immature': blocks until it can be spent. number is the count with thousands separators.

@deskOutStatusMining.description: Status of an output that is a mining reward. Narrow status column.

@deskOutStatusLocked.description: Status of an output locked by a send. Narrow status column.

@deskOutNoteBySend.description: Small grey note after the status 'Locked': which send locked it.

@deskOutNoteByPendingSend.description: Small grey note after the status 'Locked' on Outputs: a payment still on its way holds the coin; {date} is the day it started.

@deskOutStatusSpent.description: Status of an output that was spent. Narrow status column.

@deskOutTxReceived.description: Link in the outputs table to the transaction an output came from: incoming, with a short date.

@deskOutTxSent.description: Link in the outputs table to the transaction an output belongs to: outgoing, with a short date.

@deskOutCopyCommitment.description: Tooltip of the copy button next to a commitment; short is its shortened form.

deskOutSplitSpentPart: {count, plural, one{{count} output ({amount} EPIC)} other{{count} outputs ({amount} EPIC)}}

@deskOutSplitSpentPart.description: Bold part of the Split and Consolidate dialog text: how many outputs are spent and what they hold.

@deskOutSplitMadePart.description: Bold part of the Split dialog text: how many outputs are made and the size of each.

@deskOutConsMadePart.description: Bold part of the Consolidate dialog text: the single output that is made.

deskOutSplitDialogText: Spends {spent} and makes {made} each. Everything spendable is locked for {blocks, plural, one{1 confirmation} other{{blocks} confirmations}}.

@deskOutSplitDialogText.description: Paragraph in the Split dialog. The two placeholders are shown in bold; keep them as whole pieces. {blocks} is the wallet's minimum confirmations (Settings > Advanced): blocks until the change confirms.

deskOutConsDialogText: Spends {spent} and makes {made}. Everything spendable is locked for {blocks, plural, one{1 confirmation} other{{blocks} confirmations}}.

@deskOutConsDialogText.description: Paragraph in the Consolidate dialog. The two placeholders are shown in bold; keep them as whole pieces. {blocks} is the wallet's minimum confirmations (Settings > Advanced): blocks until the change confirms.

@deskOutFactFee.description: Label in the dialog's facts list: the fee of the transaction.

@deskOutFactEach.description: Label in the Split dialog's facts list: the size of every new output.

@deskOutFactAbout.description: Value in the Split dialog's facts list.

@deskOutFactLocked.description: Label in the dialog's facts list: the amount locked while the transaction confirms.

deskOutFactLockedValue: {amount} EPIC, {blocks, plural, one{about 1 block} other{about {blocks} blocks}}. Nothing stays spendable.

@deskOutFactLockedValue.description: Value in the dialog's facts list: how much is locked and for how long. {blocks} is the wallet's minimum confirmations (Settings > Advanced): blocks until the change confirms.

@deskOutMakeLabel.description: Label of the number stepper in the Split dialog; also its screen reader label.

@deskOutMakeRange.description: Small text under 'Outputs to make': the allowed range.

@deskOutStepperFewer.description: Tooltip of the minus button of the number stepper.

@deskOutStepperMore.description: Tooltip of the plus button of the number stepper.

@deskOutFeeWorking.description: Line with a spinner in the dialog while the fee is estimated.

@deskOutNoEstimate.description: Title of the red notice in the dialog when the fee could not be estimated; the reason follows.

deskOutEachMin: Each output must be at least 0.5 EPIC.

@deskOutEachMin.description: Warning in the Split dialog when the outputs would be too small.

deskOutNotEnoughFee: Not enough to pay the fee.

@deskOutNotEnoughFee.description: Warning in the Consolidate dialog when the outputs do not cover the fee.

@deskOutSplitInto.description: Primary button of the Split dialog: split into this many outputs.

@deskOutConsolidateButton.description: Primary button of the Consolidate dialog.

deskOutPostingSplit: Building and posting the split. Keep the app open.

@deskOutPostingSplit.description: Line with a spinner in the Split dialog while the transaction is built and sent.

deskOutPostingCons: Building and posting the consolidate. Keep the app open.

@deskOutPostingCons.description: Line with a spinner in the Consolidate dialog while the transaction is built and sent.

@deskOutSplitPosted.description: Title of the green notice in the Split dialog when it worked.

@deskOutConsPosted.description: Title of the green notice in the Consolidate dialog when it worked.

deskOutSplitDoneText: {count, plural, one{{count} output of about {amount} EPIC, confirming. Locked for {blocks, plural, one{1 confirmation} other{{blocks} confirmations}}.} other{{count} outputs of about {amount} EPIC, confirming. Locked for {blocks, plural, one{1 confirmation} other{{blocks} confirmations}}.}}

@deskOutSplitDoneText.description: Text of the green notice in the Split dialog when it worked. {blocks} is the wallet's minimum confirmations (Settings > Advanced): blocks until the change confirms.

deskOutConsDoneText: One output of {amount} EPIC, confirming. Locked for {blocks, plural, one{1 confirmation} other{{blocks} confirmations}}.

@deskOutConsDoneText.description: Text of the green notice in the Consolidate dialog when it worked. {blocks} is the wallet's minimum confirmations (Settings > Advanced): blocks until the change confirms.

@deskOutNotPostedTitle.description: Title of the red notice when the node did not take the transaction.

deskOutNotPostedSplit: The split was built and stored, but the node did not take it. Post it again, or cancel it to unlock the outputs.

@deskOutNotPostedSplit.description: Text of the red notice in the Split dialog when the node did not take the transaction.

deskOutNotPostedCons: The consolidate was built and stored, but the node did not take it. Post it again, or cancel it to unlock the outputs.

@deskOutNotPostedCons.description: Text of the red notice in the Consolidate dialog when the node did not take the transaction.

@deskOutCancelSplit.description: Button in the Split dialog: cancel the stored transaction. Short.

@deskOutCancelCons.description: Button in the Consolidate dialog: cancel the stored transaction. Short.

@deskOutPostAgain.description: Primary button: send the stored transaction to the node again. Short.

@deskOutNotDoneTitle.description: Title of the red notice in the dialog when it failed.

@deskOutNotDoneText.description: Text of the red notice in the dialog when it failed; error is the reason (a sentence without final full stop).

@deskOutSomethingWrong.description: Reason shown when nothing more is known about why the split or consolidate failed.

@deskOutTryAgain.description: Primary button of the failure state in the dialog. Short.

@deskOutToastNotPosted.description: Title of the toast when posting again failed; the reason follows as its text.

@deskOutToastNotCancelled.description: Title of the toast when cancelling the stored transaction failed; the reason follows as its text.

@deskOutPostingDesc.description: Description in the dialog header while posting.

@deskOutDoneDesc.description: Description in the dialog header when it worked.

deskOutSplitDesc: More outputs, so several sends can follow each other.

@deskOutSplitDesc.description: Description in the Split dialog header.

@deskOutConsDesc.description: Description in the Consolidate dialog header.

deskOutNothingText: Nothing to consolidate: the wallet has {what}.

@deskOutNothingText.description: Text of the dialog shown when there is nothing to consolidate (the wallet has one spendable output, or the core says fewer than two); the placeholder is shown in bold.

@deskOutWhatFewer.description: Bold part of the 'nothing to consolidate' text.

@deskOutWhatOne.description: Bold part of the 'nothing to consolidate' text.

deskOutDefaultsMoved: The strategy and Split change for sends are set in Settings › Payments.

@deskOutDefaultsMoved.description: One line on Outputs, under the management cards, shown while Advanced › Send options is on: where the defaults for sends went.

@deskOutDefaultsOpen.description: Inline button after deskOutDefaultsMoved: opens Settings › Transactions.

@deskOutNoteWaitingRecipient.description: Small grey note after the status 'Waiting for the response' on an output of a send. Lower case.

@deskOutFilterWaiting.description: Outputs filter: outputs awaiting finalization, which are in no balance figure and not in All (UD-008).
